metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow snagged 1 unlucky fool? Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Clicked like I lost my mouse in a hurricane.
Enemy probably uninstalling or questioning life.
Did NOT deserve that chaos but hey, I’ll take it.
If your aim’s a beautiful mess, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s more accident than skill!
